verdict.rationale: Temporal is a platform with a service API, so asking for a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file it did find is a documentation index, not an API specification, so it is an adjacent artifact and earns no credit. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI, protobuf or equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
